_comment: Category taxonomy for twopaws.pet. Each category maps raw supplier categoryNames (as they appear in catalogueBrowse facets) and an optional petType onto one landing page at /shop/{pet}/{slug}/. Matching is case- and accent-insensitive. Edit here; the build and the client read this file.

cats.name: Cats
cats.description: Everything for your cat in Egypt: dry and wet food, litter, treats, toys and care, delivered in Cairo and Giza from trusted suppliers.

dogs.description: Dog food, treats, collars, beds and care from TwoPaws suppliers, with same-day delivery across Cairo and Giza.
